name: Oil of Sharpness

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 1 minute to apply: a Slashing or Piercing weapon (or 5 pieces of such ammunition) becomes +3 for 1 hour.
text: This clear, gelatinous oil sparkles with tiny, ultrathin silver shards. The oil can coat one Melee weapon or up to 5 pieces of ammunition that deal Slashing or Piercing damage. Applying it takes 1 minute. For 1 hour, the coated item has a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
